The test image shows a mango leaf with a dark, moldy coating. The underlying leaf is still green. This matches the description of Sooty Mould, which is a superficial fungus. The reference image for Sooty Mould also shows a similar dark, superficial fungal growth on the leaf surface. The other diseases have different symptoms. Anthracnose causes black spots, Die Back affects twigs, and Powdery Mildew is whitish. Therefore, Sooty Mould is the most likely diagnosis.
